messages:
maria_ng: dropping notes from quick pairing on 'compact coalesce + slot smoothing' idea. aim: tame p99 during microbursts while keeping per-token cost steady
samir: seen the issue: tenant Y blasts 150 reqs in ~1.8s, p99 jumps. our current coalesce max window is too blunt
jin_park: tl;dr tradeoff: tiny windows = low tail but poor packing -> more kernel launches. big windows = great packing, worse tail and KV eviction
anya_ops: customers want interactive feel on chat routes (p95<120ms) but finance cares about <10% cost increase
maria_ng: proposed runtime policy (sketch): split into two queues: fastpath (tiny short requests) and compact (normal/long). fastpath has bounded quota and minimal coalesce, compact uses adaptive window + slot-smoothing credits
samir: starvation scenario: fastpath saturates and prevents compact batches from forming. need a deterministic backstop
jin_park: add deterministic drains: every M fastpath-served requests trigger a forced compact drain. also track compact_lateness metric to force more drains if compact backlog grows
maria_ng: slot-smoothing: give compact batches "smoothing credits" based on recent utilization. credits let us artificially extend compact window by X ms when credits available to absorb bursts
anya_ops: how to avoid oscillation across tenants? bursts can be diurnal; we should cap per-tenant window changes and put a cooldown after notable resize
samir: implement step limiter: window can only change +/- S ms per second and then a cooldown period T after a forced drain/canary resize
jin_park: tie KV importance: attach cache_priority score to requests; scheduler biases flush when average cache_priority>threshold so we avoid evicting hot KV entries
maria_ng: control knobs we sketched:
```
coalesce:
  fastpath_token_limit: 128
  fastpath_quota_per_sec: 150
  compact_min_ms: 2
  compact_max_ms: 60
  smoothing_credit_ms: 40
  forced_drain_every: 30
  step_limit_ms_per_sec: 10
  cooldown_after_resize_s: 10
  kv_bias_threshold: 0.7
```

anya_ops: required telemetry: fastpath_ratio, compact_fill_pct, smoothing_credits, forced_drains, compact_lateness, kv_evictions_by_route. ops wants alert if fastpath_ratio>0.75 for 45s or compact_lateness>3s
maria_ng: rollout plan: small canary fleet with synthetic and replayed traces, monitor p50/p95/p99, token cost delta, KV hit-rate. abort if p99 regresses >10% or cost >12%
jin_park: implementation notes: we can reuse existing enqueue hooks; add a minimal state per-tenant for credits + cooldown. keep it lock-free as much as possible
samir: follow-ups: I'll draft a short RFC capturing policy, config, metrics, and test matrix. tag CI bot for perf runs
ci-bot: perf-run scheduled: compact-smoothing-canary x3, region-us-east-1, ETA 180s
